header.label: Open source landscape
header.title: New open source BIM and CAD from others
header.desc: OpenAEC is not the only one. More and more new open source BIM and CAD programs are coming from other companies and makers. Here they are side by side: who is behind them, when they started, how many people contribute and how many stars they have on GitHub. Under All you also find a few established names for comparison.

chart.title: GitHub stars per project
chart.sub: Stars are a rough measure of reach, not of quality. Hover over a bar for the details.

table.note: Started = date of the first commit in the public git history; a project may have begun earlier. Contributors = number of contributors to the repository according to GitHub. The figures are updated automatically; missing a project? Write to info@open-aec.com.
